brief: Goldman's daily roundup leads with memory: constructive on 2027 industry fundamentals from strong AI memory demand, but more measured on 2028 given AI capex sustainability concerns, muted consumer demand and rising China supply, driving lower 2028E DRAM/NAND price forecasts, a higher HBM TAM, and cut price targets for Samsung, SK Hynix, CXMT and Kioxia, all kept Buy-rated on the view that shares already discount a severe downside. Japan semicap names, Foxconn Industrial Internet and Victory Giant are framed around AI server-rack and PCB capacity expansion. On US Internet, record hyperscaler capex (over $170bn in 3Q26) and accelerating cloud growth support Buy theses on Amazon, Alphabet and SpaceX built around AI monetization and capital allocation. US Strategy flags the S&P 500's 12% drop from its October 6 high, widening from an AI unwind into a broader growth downgrade, and names three conditions for a bottom despite hedge funds already near a multi-year low in net leverage. Rates and FX sections describe risk-off unwinding hawkish Fed repricing, while still expecting near-term dollar strength and USD/JPY intervention risk near 160. Also includes single-name calls on HK Exchanges (downgrade), Westlife Foodworld (downgrade), China data centers, China semis, ASEAN bank data-center loan exposure, Korea insurers and Mizuho.
